_note: Config for tools/build-demo.mjs. Run build-logic.mjs FIRST (it vendors the server into logic.js and reads the name scrubs from THIS file), then: node tools/build-demo.mjs demos/elc-assessments/build.json. The source Index.html is a whole document with no template tokens; the first replacement loads logic.js early in <head>, ahead of the shim/data/mock block build-demo.mjs injects before </head>. The "today" reads (request age, the New Assessment form defaults, print timestamps) go through window.ELC_DEMO_NOW, the demo's pinned clock (Tue 2026-10-13), so the form agrees with the server about the school year and season. The school is swapped for a fictional one (name, street address, the HCS abbreviation in two help sentences) and the 400 KB embedded crest for a generated badge (replaceRegex: the one value too large to quote). People named in the source comments are replaced by nameAliases: keys are sha256 hashes of the lowercased word or phrase (up to three words), values a fabricated student from data.js, so this public file never names anyone. build-logic.mjs applies the same table to the vendored server.
